parent.name: Original frozen Stage1 f696 allocation plus b472 action/risk/recovery under exact source clocks and raw-share books

single_mechanism: Add to the original Stage1 allocation objective the mean positive shortfall of every contiguous 126-session training-window daily-average log wealth relative to SOXX. The window 126 and 70%-positive evaluation gate are frozen contract v2 values, not selected from 2023+ intervals. The added term has coefficient exactly 1 in the same daily-log units as the base objective; retain all original absolute drawdown, cash, 5-day tail, turnover, classification and auxiliary terms.
closed_route_distinction: The closed annual_shortfall_training_20261015 replaced the annual standard-deviation term with annual negative-excess RMS. This design retains that original annual term and adds a 126-session all-window penalty; it does not tune or resume the closed annual version.

model.same_inputs: original 39 primary and 16 common features; no new feature, source, label or imputation
model.same_optimizer: original AdamW, auxiliary weight, original 20-row purge and original final-epoch selection
model.loss_coordinate: mean(ReLU(-rolling126_daily_average_log_excess)) over every contiguous original mature 2011-2022 training interval; no look at 2023+ outcomes
model.matched_initialization: For each seed, candidate and original Stage1 source model must have exact initial parameter tensors and identical predictions before fitting.
